message.content:
Sure! To check the status of your complaint, you can follow these steps:

1. **Log in to the portal**  
   - Go to the official portal website (e.g., `https://portal.example.com`).  
   - Enter your username and password. If you don’t remember your credentials, use the “Forgot Password” link to reset them.

2. **Navigate to the “Complaints” section**  
   - Once logged in, look for a menu item or tab labeled **“Complaints”**, **“My Complaints”**, or something similar.  
   - Click on it to view a list of complaints you’ve submitted.

3. **Find your complaint**  
   - The portal will display a table or list of complaints.  
   - Look for the complaint ID or the title you used when submitting.  
   - If you have many complaints, you can use the search or filter options to narrow it down.

4. **View the status**  
   - Click on the complaint ID or the “View Details” button next to the complaint.  
   - The details page will show the current status (e.g., “Under Review,” “In Progress,” “Resolved”) and any updates or comments from the support team.

5. **Check for notifications**  
   - Some portals also send email or SMS notifications when the status changes.  
   - Make sure your contact information is up to date in your profile settings.

6. **Contact support if needed**  
   - If you can’t find the complaint or the status isn’t updated after a reasonable time, you can contact customer support via the portal’s “Help” or “Contact Us” section.  
   - Provide your complaint ID and any relevant details so they can assist you quickly.

If you run into any trouble or need further assistance, let me know!
